title: DIY Raised Koi Pond with Glass Window (Concrete Build)
excerpt: A complete DIY raised koi pond built in concrete with a glass viewing window and a custom filtration system. Full specs and setup explained.
body:
## Overview In 2017 I started building my concrete raised koi pond with a glass window and a DIY filtration system. The objective was to create a clean and functional pond with good visibility, water quality and manageable maintenance. ## Pond Specifications - Capacity: 2450 Liters (647 Gallons) - Dimensions: 1750mm x 1550mm x 900mm ## Glass Window The pond includes a frontal viewing window which allows a clear view of the fish. - Size: 800mm x 400mm - Thickness: 12mm ## Filtration System The filtration system is built using two 220L barrels. ### Stage 1 (Mechanical Filtration) - 6 filter brushes ### Stage 2 (Biological Filtration) - Japanese mat - Lava rock ## UV Sterilization A 40W UV lamp runs between 9PM and 5AM from May to September. ## Pump System - 8000 L/h to 15000 L/h flow rate ## Image Gallery
## Contact If you build something similar, feel free to share your results. 👉 Contact me via the contact page
